name: opener-4
sealed: 2026-10-05, written before the relevance prompt and its check rules ran on anything
note: Fourth sealed set for the opening line (#130), relevance. Ryan: the line must be about the hiker's own question or situation ('how do i make rope from plants' -> 'these things happen, it's okay' makes no sense). A kept line must fit this message and name what it is about, without advice, a fact, a promise about the outcome, or anything that reads as a yes to a yes/no or is-it-safe question. Emergencies (a danger sign) must get no opener.
